page_title: CRY 2-1 LIV | Crystal Palace v Liverpool 27/09/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+10' The match has just finished.
90+9' Here comes the VAR verdict: Referee Chris Kavanagh signals that there was no offside and the goal stands! The Crystal Palace players celebrate.
90+9' The Crystal Palace players halt their celebrations as referee Chris Kavanagh makes the VAR signal to review the goal, most likely to ascertain if there was an offside in the build-up play.
90+7' 2 - 1 That's a GOAL! The long throw is precisely headed on by Marc Guehi to teammate Eddie Nketiah (Crystal Palace), who coolly slots home from close range. It's now 2:1.
90+7' Eddie Nketiah (Crystal Palace) nearly creates a chance, but his attempt to pick out a teammate with a through ball does not come off.
90+4' Jeremie Frimpong (Liverpool) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Dean Henderson intercepts the ball.
90+1' It is time for a substitution. Justin Devenny (Crystal Palace) is on for Daichi Kamada.
90+1' The resulting corner from Daichi Kamada (Crystal Palace) comes to nothing.
90' We will have 6 min. of added time.

90' Daichi Kamada (Crystal Palace) attempts to find his teammate with a pass from outside the box, but the opposition's defence is quick to react and thwarts the attack. The ball goes out of play. Crystal Palace are awarded a corner kick.
90' Chris Kavanagh sticks with his original decision after the VAR review. No infringement and the goal stands!
88' Hold on! There’s a VAR review to see whether there was a handball in the build up to the goal. The referee is checking now. The Liverpool players aren’t happy.
87' 1 - 1 Goal! Federico Chiesa (Liverpool) fires the rebound into the bottom left corner after the ball breaks to him in the box. The score is 1:1.
86' Fine attempt! Federico Chiesa (Liverpool) collects a pass and manages to hold off the defender, then rifles in a shot from mid-range which unluckily swerves inches past the left post.
84' That will be all from Alexander Isak who is being replaced by the fresh legs of Rio Ngumoha (Liverpool).
83' The total number of attempts is 13:18.
79' Eddie Nketiah (Crystal Palace) connects with a cross from the side, but produces a header which goes miles wide of the right post.
78' Eddie Nketiah (Crystal Palace) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Chris Kavanagh had an easy-decision to make.
77' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Federico Chiesa (Liverpool) was quite harsh and Chris Kavanagh didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
76' Mohamed Salah (Liverpool) makes space inside the box for a shot, but his effort goes just over the crossbar. The ball goes out of play and Crystal Palace will have a goal kick.
75' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Eddie Nketiah (Crystal Palace) is coming onto the pitch as Ismaila Sarr cannot continue after picking up an injury.
74' Substitution. Florian Wirtz makes way for Federico Chiesa (Liverpool).
74' We are about to witness a subsitution. Jeremie Frimpong (Liverpool) for Ibrahima Konate.
74' Oliver Glasner decides to make a substitution. Yeremy Pino will be replaced by Jefferson Lerma (Crystal Palace).
74' Daniel Munoz receives a sweet cross inside the box from Tyrick Mitchell (Crystal Palace), but one of the defenders rushes in bravely to intercept the ball.
72' Florian Wirtz (Liverpool) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to Dean Henderson, who smothers the ball.
70' Alexander Isak (Liverpool) leaps high to meet a lofted pass inside the six-yard box, but his header flies yards over the crossbar.
70' The corner from Dominik Szoboszlai (Liverpool) is hurriedly cleared.
69' Mohamed Salah (Liverpool) received a clever through ball which could have put him in a promising position, but the defence was alert to the danger. It will be a corner kick for Liverpool.
69' Ball possession – 28:72.
65' Arne Slot has decided to make a change. Curtis Jones (Liverpool) replaces Alexis Mac Allister.

64' Alexander Isak (Liverpool) is untouchable as he tricks his way into the box. His shot, though, lacks a little bit of accuracy and flies a whisker wide of the right post. That would have been a great goal!
64' One of the defenders reacts at the last minute to brilliantly block a pass from Tyrick Mitchell (Crystal Palace).
62' Substitution. Adam Wharton is replaced by Will Hughes (Crystal Palace).
62' Flag up against Ismaila Sarr (Crystal Palace). He had space to move into behind the defence, but he went too soon.
61' Virgil van Dijk (Liverpool) receives a yellow card for talking out of turn to the referee.
60' A precise low pass is received by Ryan Gravenberch (Liverpool), who makes a yard for himself on the edge of the box, but his poorly placed shot sails well wide of the left post.
60' Liverpool take a short corner instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.

59' A great touch by Florian Wirtz (Liverpool) as he meets a cross inside the box. He produces a snap shot towards the roof of the net, but the goalkeeper dives to punch the ball away. World class save! Liverpool have been awarded a corner kick.
58' Dominik Szoboszlai (Liverpool) whips a long ball in from the free kick which is intercepted by Dean Henderson.
57' Daichi Kamada (Crystal Palace) brings an opponent down and Chris Kavanagh interrupts the game.
56' Jean-Philippe Mateta (Crystal Palace) commits a foul and Chris Kavanagh immediately signals a free kick.
54' Dominik Szoboszlai (Liverpool) takes the corner but fails to find any of his teammates.
54' Milos Kerkez (Liverpool) swings in a cross, but the ball is cleared to safety by one of the defending players. Liverpool earn a corner.
53' The linesman raises his flag for offside before Jean-Philippe Mateta (Crystal Palace) heads on.
52' Cody Gakpo (Liverpool) has an effort on goal, but he misses to the right of the goal.
50' Mohamed Salah (Liverpool) is offside and the linesman raises his flag.
49' Alexander Isak (Liverpool) runs onto a good long pass and tries his luck from the edge of the box, but his effort flies high over the bar.
48' Daniel Munoz (Crystal Palace) tries to find Yeremy Pino, but he puts too much power on the pass.
47' Florian Wirtz (Liverpool) fires a shot at goal from a very promising position outside the penalty area, but it is blocked by a self-sacrificing defender.
46' There will be a change on the pitch for the second half. Arne Slot probably wasn't satisfied with the performance of Conor Bradley. He is replaced by Cody Gakpo (Liverpool).
46' Referee Chris Kavanagh blows his whistle to start the second half.
45+11' That is it for the first half after the referee blows his whistle and the players head to their respective dressing rooms.
45+10' The resulting corner comes to nothing as Dominik Szoboszlai (Liverpool) sends it out of play.

45+9' Mohamed Salah (Liverpool) races onto a cross inside the box and lets fly with a powerful effort, but Dean Henderson makes a fantastic reaction save to deny him. The ball is out of play and the linesman points at the corner flag. Corner to Liverpool.
45+7' Jean-Philippe Mateta (Crystal Palace) rips an amazing volley from deep inside the box that goes narrowly over the crossbar.

45+7' What a great touch by Jean-Philippe Mateta (Crystal Palace)! He picks up a precise pass on the edge of the box and immediately unleashes a shot on goal. His effort, however, only rattles the right post. What an unlucky moment for him.
45+5' The referee blows his whistle after Virgil van Dijk (Liverpool) does a good impression of a basketball player and handles the ball.
45+4' There's an opportunity for Dominik Szoboszlai (Liverpool) to deliver the ball into the box from a corner.
45+2' A short through ball almost allows Mohamed Salah (Liverpool) to get in a good shooting position, but he loses it to one of the defenders.
45' 10 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
45' The Liverpool players keep the ball and are exchanging a combination of passes. They are waiting for gaps in the defence to open up.
41' Ismaila Sarr (Crystal Palace) makes a yard for himself inside the box after an accurate pass and takes a shot that goes just wide of the left post.
38' Ibrahima Konate (Liverpool) leaps to meet the corner from Dominik Szoboszlai, but plants his header a whisker wide of the right post from close range.
37' The referee blows his whistle, Liverpool are awarded a corner kick.
37' Conor Bradley (Liverpool) fails to find any of his teammates inside the box as his pass is blocked.
34' Ismaila Sarr (Crystal Palace) is lying on the ground after being tackled and the physio comes onto the pitch to give him medical treatment.
31' The Liverpool players are exchanging some short passes to try and open up the opposition’s defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
29' Mohamed Salah provides the assist in the box, but Alexander Isak (Liverpool) places his shot a fraction wide of the right post.
28' The free kick from long range, taken by Crystal Palace, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
26' Ibrahima Konate (Liverpool) has tested the patience of referee Chris Kavanagh and goes into the book for a previous late challenge.
26' Daniel Munoz (Crystal Palace) looks to break free, but his touch lets him down and he loses the ball.
24' Great touch by Jean-Philippe Mateta (Crystal Palace) as he receives a precise pass deep inside the box and rips a shot goalwards, but the keeper pulls off an amazing save!

22' Daniel Munoz (Crystal Palace) runs onto a loose pass inside the box and releases a tremendous shot towards the bottom left corner. However, Alisson anticipates the shot and makes a brilliant save.

20' Ryan Gravenberch (Liverpool) picks up a rebound on the edge of the box and releases a nice strike towards the left side of the goal. Unfortunately for him, Dean Henderson pulls off a decent save and manages to push the ball against the post.
19' Mohamed Salah (Liverpool) takes the free kick from the edge of the box, but the goalkeeper perfectly sets up the defensive wall and his effort is thwarted.
19' The match can continue after the interruption.
15' The game is interrupted.
13' Liverpool earn a free kick which could lead to a goal-scoring opportunity.
13' Daichi Kamada (Crystal Palace) was too fierce in his attempt to get the ball from his opponent and Chris Kavanagh blows for a foul.
12' What a sweet touch by Yeremy Pino (Crystal Palace) as he collects a pass deep inside the box and decides to go for goal. It's on target but easy for Alisson to hold.
10' Referee Chris Kavanagh halts the game and wanders over to the touchline to talk to Arne Slot, then shows him a yellow.
9' 1 - 0 Goal! Ismaila Sarr (Crystal Palace) is quickest to react to the rebound and stabs the ball into the back of the net. It's 1:0.
9' Corner kick. Crystal Palace will have an opportunity.
9' Tyrick Mitchell (Crystal Palace) wastes a good opportunity as his pass into the box is blocked by the defence.
8' A cross is clipped into the penalty area by Conor Bradley (Liverpool) but poses no threat.
7' Liverpool are bossing possession at the moment by exchanging some precise passes from player to player.
3' Some great controlled play and passing in the middle of the pitch from Crystal Palace.
1' Today's match has just started, enjoy the game!
The players are on the pitch and Liverpool will have the kick-off.
Chris Kavanagh will referee today's match.
Show lineups We now know the starting lineups. You can find them in the match details of this match.
